description: A parent is trying to understand what usually triggers their child's after-school meltdowns by comparing several recent days that looked similar on the surface but felt different in outcome.

user_profile.persona: 34-year-old parent who notices emotional patterns but struggles to interpret them
user_profile.context: The child is not 'always difficult,' but the parent cannot yet see what factors make the bad days worse
user_profile.communication_style: Observant and reflective, wants patterns rather than quick fixes

fact_sheet.fact: Leo Chen is 6 years old and is in the first grade at Maple Creek Elementary School.
Leo Chen has a documented sensory sensitivity to loud, unexpected noises, noted in his file by pediatrician Dr. Anya Sharma.
On the night of Sunday, October 20th, 2024, Leo Chen went to bed at 8:15 PM and woke up at 6:45 AM, totaling 10.5 hours of sleep.
On Monday, October 21st, 2024, Leo Chen's school day at Maple Creek Elementary ran from 8:30 AM to 3:00 PM.
A surprise fire drill occurred at Maple Creek Elementary School at 10:05 AM on Monday, October 21st, 2024.
Leo Chen attended the 'Adventure Club' after-school program from 3:00 PM until his parent, Alex, picked him up at 5:10 PM on Monday, October 21st.
The after-school snack provided by Adventure Club on Monday, October 21st, was a bag of pretzels and a 4.23 oz apple juice box.
At 5:45 PM on Monday, October 21st, Leo Chen had an intense 20-minute meltdown involving crying and yelling after being asked to put his backpack away.
On the night of Monday, October 21st, 2024, Leo Chen went to bed at 8:05 PM and woke up at 7:05 AM, totaling 11 hours of sleep.
On Tuesday, October 22nd, 2024, Alex picked Leo Chen up from the Adventure Club at 4:30 PM.
For an after-school snack on Tuesday, October 22nd, Alex gave Leo Chen a cheese stick and a handful of grapes in the car immediately upon pickup.
The main activity at Adventure Club on Tuesday, October 22nd, was a quiet reading and drawing session in the school library.
On Tuesday, October 22nd, 2024, Leo Chen was calm and cooperative after school, helping to set the table for dinner at 6:00 PM without prompting.
On the night of Tuesday, October 22nd, 2024, Leo Chen went to bed at 8:00 PM and woke up at 6:30 AM, totaling 10.5 hours of sleep.
On Wednesday, October 23rd, 2024, Leo Chen's class had a substitute teacher, Mr. Gable, as his regular teacher, Ms. Albright, was out sick.
For lunch on Wednesday, October 23rd, Leo Chen reported that he did not eat his packed turkey sandwich because another child said the bread looked 'squishy'.
The activity at Adventure Club on Wednesday, October 23rd, was a high-energy game of dodgeball in the gymnasium.
Alex picked Leo Chen up from Adventure Club at 5:15 PM on Wednesday, October 23rd.
The provided snack at Adventure Club on Wednesday, October 23rd, was a granola bar containing peanuts, which Leo Chen dislikes and did not eat.
A meltdown occurred on Wednesday, October 23rd, at 5:25 PM in the car on the way home, triggered by Alex asking Leo about his day.
Alex noted that on both Monday and Wednesday evenings, Leo's backpack contained three unfinished classwork papers.
Leo Chen's Individualized Education Program (IEP) allows him to use noise-canceling headphones during loud school activities, but he often forgets to ask for them.
Alex observed that on Tuesday, the 'good day,' the transition from the car to the house was slow and unhurried, taking approximately 5 minutes.
Leo Chen's 16 oz reusable water bottle was still completely full at the end of the school day on Wednesday, October 23rd.
Alex's log shows that Leo Chen's meltdowns on Monday and Wednesday both occurred within 30-40 minutes of being picked up from the after-school program.
On Monday, Leo's notable school-day and after-school schedule events were the 10:05 AM surprise fire drill and attendance at Adventure Club from 3:00 PM to 5:10 PM.
Leo's IEP accommodation for loud school activities is access to noise-canceling headphones, but the recurring problem is that he often forgets to ask for them.
On Monday, Leo followed his regular first-grade school day from 8:30 AM until dismissal at 3:00 PM, with the main deviation being the surprise fire drill at 10:05 AM.
Immediately after school dismissal on Monday, Leo transitioned straight into Adventure Club, stayed there for the full session, and was picked up by Alex at 5:10 PM.
School notes say Leo often does not ask for his noise-canceling headphones during sudden loud events because he becomes overwhelmed quickly and has trouble initiating the request once distressed.

When Leo misses the chance to use his headphones during loud activities, he tends to stay dysregulated through later transitions, which Alex has flagged as a possible contributor to after-school meltdowns.
